name: Double-Framed Ayatul Kursi
short_desc: This gallery-grade hand-painted acrylic artwork presents the complete Ayatul Kursi in a refined circular layout on textured cream canvas. Sealed with a protective gloss varnish and housed in a double shadowbox frame with gold trim, it brings formal grandeur to foyers and reception spaces.
seo_title: Luxury Double-Framed Ayatul Kursi Gallery Art – Hand-Painted Cream & Gold Acrylic Calligraphy
description:
Elevate your space with a museum-quality presentation of divine words through this handcrafted Islamic calligraphy art piece. The artwork showcases Ayatul Kursi written in a crisp, circular composition, surrounded by subtle border verses and anchored by a striking red accent on the sacred name "Allah" at the top.

Crafted with high-grade acrylic paints, the piece utilizes a pristine cream and ivory background that allows the deep black ink and gold details to stand out with exceptional clarity. The balanced design exudes quiet reverence and scholarly elegance.

A durable gloss varnish seal covers the painted surface, protecting it from moisture, dust, and UV fading over time while providing a subtle, light-reflecting sheen that highlights every calligraphic curve.

Framed in a sophisticated double shadowbox (a warm walnut outer frame paired with a gold inner trim), this artwork serves as an imposing, elegant centerpiece for formal entryways, main halls, executive suites, or grand living rooms.

Key Specifications & Features:

Medium & Materials: Premium heavy-body acrylic paints

Surface Coating: Protective gloss varnish finish for durability and color enhancement

Theme & Script: Circular Ayatul Kursi with outer calligraphic borders and red "Allah" focus

Color Palette: Cream/ivory backdrop, rich black script, red highlights, and gold flourishes

Style: Formal Gallery Shadowbox / Traditional Classical Calligraphy

Ideal Placement: Main hallway, formal foyer, reception area, or executive office
